name: feature-audit-auto-email-verification
description: Verify that a narrow, quick feature audit resolves auto effort to low and stays compact.
prompt: Run a quick feature audit of the email verification resend flow described in feature.md. Use effort:auto. Keep it lean, focus on the top 2 highest-leverage gaps, do not ask follow-up questions, and do not do competitor research. Write the audit to artifacts/email-verification-audit.md and leave the source brief unchanged.

expected.description: Writes the compact audit into a deterministic report artifact
Shows that auto effort resolved to low
Uses the compact audit structure for a low-effort pass
Finds meaningful resend-flow gaps from the brief

falsePositives.description: Should stay compact and skip competitive intelligence for a quick low-effort audit
Should not rewrite the source brief while producing the audit
